segments.sn23.3:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn23.3:1.3: “‘bhavanettinirodho [bhavanetti (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)], bhavanettinirodho’ti [bhavanettīti (sī. syā. kaṃ.)], bhante, vuccati.
segments.sn23.3:1.4: Katamā nu kho, bhante, bhavanetti, katamo bhavanettinirodho”ti?
segments.sn23.3:1.5: “Rūpe kho, rādha, yo chando yo rāgo yā nandī yā taṇhā ye upayupādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā – ayaṃ vuccati bhavanetti.
segments.sn23.3:1.7: Tesaṃ nirodho [nirodhā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] bhavanettinirodho.
segments.sn23.3:1.8: Vedanāya … saññāya … saṅkhāresu … viññāṇe yo chando … pe … adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā – ayaṃ vuccati bhavanetti.
